# Marrow Agrisupply

**Last updated:** 2026-09-15  
**Account code:** MAS (though half the floor still calls it "Marrow Agri" in Slack)  
**Parent:** Marrow Fieldworks  
**Ownership:** Central team pooled account (no single account manager) since January 2025.

Marrow Agrisupply is the farm supply retail chain under the Marrow Fieldworks umbrella, mostly moving pallets of baler twine, fencing, and calf starter across the Plains. 

**Commercials & Support:**  
40 seats on SLA Tier 1 under its affiliate amendment; all other terms follow the parent MSA.

**Operational notes:**  
Because it’s pooled, whoever grabs the queue first gets the joy of explaining why the Salina cross-dock can't book three flatbed deliveries into Door 4 at 06:00. Their receiving clerks love overriding gate check-in timestamps and then filing tickets (see #PD-88412) claiming the *Daily Yard Dwell* report is broken. If you pick up a call from their Kearney depot, remind them to close out yesterday's trailers before blaming the software.
